title: Websites and apps: who founded them

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?founderLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?founder) WHERE { { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q35127 } UNION { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q620615 } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks ; wdt:P112 ?c . ?c wdt:P31 wd:Q5 . FILTER(?sitelinks > 15) } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?c)<=1) ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 300 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 199
